description: This file defines the Zend_Uri_Http class, which handles HTTP and HTTPS URI parsing, validation, and manipulation within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Uri_Http
classes.description: A class for handling HTTP and HTTPS URIs, including parsing, validation, and various accessor/mutator methods.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Uri_Http instance from a URI string starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

methods.name: _parseUri
methods.description: Parses the scheme-specific part of the URI into its components: username, password, host, port, path, query, fragment.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Constructs the full URI string from the current instance variables.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Validates all parts of the URI to ensure they conform to RFC rules.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username component of the URI, or false if not set.

methods.name: validateUsername
methods.description: Validates a proposed username for the URI.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username component, returning the previous value.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password component, or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Validates a proposed password for the URI.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password component, returning the previous value.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component, or false if not set.

methods.name: validateHost
methods.description: Validates the host component against hostname rules.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host component, returning the previous value.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number, or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePort
methods.description: Validates the port number to be numeric and within valid range.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port component, returning the previous value.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component, defaulting to '/' if empty.

methods.name: validatePath
methods.description: Validates the path component against RFC rules.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path component, returning the previous value.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the raw query string, or false if not present.

methods.name: getQueryAsArray
methods.description: Returns the query string as an associative array.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates the query string against RFC rules.

methods.name: addReplaceQueryParameters
methods.description: Adds or replaces query parameters and returns the previous query.

methods.name: removeQueryParameters
methods.description: Removes specified query parameters and returns the previous query.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query string, accepting strings or arrays, and returns the previous query.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component, or false if not present.

methods.name: validateFragment
methods.description: Validates the fragment component.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Sets the fragment component, returning the previous value.
